## About
Lino's HVAC is a local heating, ventilation and air conditioning company in Union, serving the North Jersey area. We are fully licensed and insured to perform heating and air conditioning services in New Jersey, residential and commercial, and we are certified by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Our technicians are NATE Certified.
On every job our technicians arrive in company uniform. We put protective booties over our work boots, and once the job is done we aim to leave the area as clean as, or cleaner than, when we arrived. Before we leave, you will understand how and why the problem happened and what was done to fix it.
One reviewer called us their first call for any HVAC concerns. Another wrote that we found the real problem with their boiler after another company quoted a part replacement.

## Services
- Heating: Service, repair, maintenance and installation of heating systems, all makes and models, for homes and commercial buildings.
- Cooling / Air Conditioning: Air conditioning service, repair and installation. One reviewer said we came out as early as we could fit them in when their AC stopped working during a heatwave.
- Air Cleaning & Purification: Equipment to improve the air quality inside your home.
- Service & Maintenance Plans: Ongoing service to keep your heating and cooling equipment dependable and working efficiently.
- Dual-zone mini-split systems: One reviewer had a dual-zone mini-split system installed to supplement their existing HVAC and described the work as quick, detailed and fairly priced.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on both homes and businesses?
A: Yes. We service, repair, maintain and install all makes and models, commercial and residential.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve towns across Hudson, Bergen, Union, Middlesex, Somerset, Essex, Passaic, Morris and Burlington counties. Call us to confirm your town.

Q: How long will I wait for the technician?
A: We strive to give you a 2-hour window, so you can go about your day.

Q: Is the diagnostic fee applied to the repair?
A: One reviewer noted that the diagnostic fee was credited toward their repair. Ask us about your job when you call.

## What customers say
- "Lino's saved us from a $726 mistake. Another company diagnosed a damaged part and quoted $726.82 to replace it. Lino's found the real problem: the cover plate over the pilot/flame sight hole on our boiler was missing, so flame rollout kept tripping the safety sensor. They installed the plates, verified temperatures (132° near the sensor vs. the 350° trip point), checked for carbon monoxide (none), and inspected the heat exchanger. Honest, thorough, and they explain everything. Their diagnostic fee is credited toward the repair. Highly recommend." (Jeffrey Mariano (Jeff's), 5/5)
- "I couldn’t be happier with Lino’s HVAC! They installed a dual-zone mini-split system to supplement my existing HVAC, and the experience was outstanding. The team was pleasant, professional, and respectful of my home. They completed the work quickly while paying great attention to detail, all at a fair price.

It’s refreshing to find a company that delivers quality work at a reasonable cost. I highly recommend Lino’s HVAC and will absolutely use them for any future HVAC needs!" (Bryan Reinhart, 5/5)
- "Fantastic! Fast response time, knowledgeable, honest and easy fix. I found them through a Google search. They came out as early as they could fit me in when my AC stopped working during this massive (103°!) heatwave. I can’t recommend them enough." (Gina Areche, 5/5)
- "Lino’s is always my first call and go to for any HVAC concerns. They’re trustworthy, reliable, and reasonable on price. I’ve recommended them personally multiple times and am grateful for their help throughout the years." (Lisa Lemon, 5/5)
